comment: The League modes' own Civilopedia keys and art in standalone mode (batch 0).
Made by hand from the art audit (C:/Dev/_handoff/audit/missing-art.md); read by
C7Engine/GameSetup.LeagueArt.cs (keys, unit art, leader heads), ArtGen/civilopedia_icons
(league entries for PediaIcons.txt and icon_files.lua) and EngineTests (LeagueArtTest).
Per mode and section, by the item's exact name: key = its Civilopedia key in standalone
mode; art = the stem of its picture; status: new (a new picture, pending until it lands),
stock (an existing picture), done (drawn already). Units: art is the art folder name.
Leaders: by civ name, with the leader name and the portrait stem (Art/Leaderheads/<art>.png).
